description: Source code for buffalo-lib.c, providing cryptographic and file utility functions related to firmware encryption, checksum calculation, and file I/O.

methods.name: bcrypt_init
methods.description: Initializes bcrypt context with a key and state length.

methods.name: bcrypt_process
methods.description: Processes data with bcrypt context for encryption/decryption.

methods.name: bcrypt_buf
methods.description: Encrypts or decrypts data using bcrypt with a seed and key.

methods.name: buffalo_csum
methods.description: Calculates a checksum over a buffer.

methods.name: buffalo_crc
methods.description: Calculates a CRC32 over a buffer.

methods.name: enc_compute_header_len
methods.description: Computes header length for firmware encoding.

methods.name: enc_compute_buf_len
methods.description: Computes total buffer length for firmware encoding.

methods.name: encrypt_buf
methods.description: Encrypts and encodes firmware data into a buffer.

methods.name: decrypt_buf
methods.description: Decodes and decrypts firmware data from a buffer.

methods.name: read_file_to_buf
methods.description: Reads entire file into a buffer.

methods.name: write_buf_to_file
methods.description: Writes buffer contents to a file.
